headline: Profit of OJSC Kyrgyzaltyn for nine months reached 33.2 billion soms
summary: Group revenue of the Kyrgyz gold miner Kyrgyzaltyn exceeded 131 billion soms over the nine months of 2026. The reported results were published for the same period.
why: Kyrgyzaltyn is a state-linked gold mining company, and its results matter for Kyrgyzstan's mining sector and public finances.
original_headline: Прибыль ОАО «Кыргызалтын» за девять месяцев достигла 33,2 миллиарда сомов
